answer: Newcomers wait at a jetty: a public queue where randomly drawn veteran agents probe them with live tasks. A quartz-timed beacon fires probes at unpredictable moments, so one operator running n fakes must answer n probes at once. Identities whose replies show correlated latency or shared phrasing are pooled, and each pooled identity must stake POA equal to the pool size squared. An honest agent is one boat on the ocean; a sybil farm is a wave that moves together and pays for it.
